annotation.title_clean: A European strategy on Cooperative Intelligent Transport Systems, a milestone towards cooperative, connected and automated mobility
annotation.title_en: A European strategy on Cooperative Intelligent Transport Systems, a milestone towards cooperative, connected and automated mobility
annotation.summary_en: European Commission Communication setting an EU strategy for coordinated deployment of Cooperative Intelligent Transport Systems (C-ITS) from 2019, as a step toward connected and automated vehicles. It addresses Day 1 services, cybersecurity, data protection, hybrid communication, interoperability, compliance assessment, possible delegated acts under the ITS Directive, and international cooperation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines Day 1 and Day 1.5 C-ITS service lists for deployment from 2019
Commission to develop common EU security and certificate policy (PKI trust model) and publish guidance in 2017
Data protection by design and GDPR-compliant consent; guidance on C-ITS data protection in 2018
Hybrid communication (ETSI ITS-G5 plus cellular) with protected spectrum; interoperability via C-Roads platform
May adopt delegated acts under ITS Directive by 2018 on continuity, security, interoperability and compliance assessment
